name: Ookami-chan wa Daisuki o Tsutaetai!!
original_name: オオカミちゃんはだいすきを伝えたい！！
source:
Ookami-chan from Wolf Planet absolutely adores the planet's creator Ein.
Ain however, is a bit of a fool. Whether she barks "Woof!" or tries to say "I love you!", the message just doesn't get across. Still, Ookami-chan is giving it her best again today to show her love!

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/ookami.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
居住在“狼之星”上的小狼娘，最最喜欢创造这颗星球的造物主艾因了。
偏偏艾因是个有点迟钝的呆瓜——无论她是汪汪叫着“嗷呜！”，还是努力说出“我最喜欢你啦！”，这份心意都怎么也传达不到对方心里。即便如此，小狼娘今天依然拼尽全力地向他表达满满的爱意！

[译自[url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/ookami.html]官方网站[/url]]
